findings.text: The company was incorporated on 4 October 1971.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for this company.
Accounts were last made up to 31 December 2025 and are not overdue; the next accounts are due 30 June 2027.
The confirmation statement was last made up to 1 November 2025 and is not overdue; the next is due 15 November 2026.
The register records 92 outstanding charges, 0 part-satisfied and 8 satisfied, from 308 charges in total; only the first 100 charges were fetched.
One current person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1815, holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights and the right to appoint and remove directors.
The register lists 10 current officers, including 9 directors; only 100 of 120 officer records were fetched, so some officers may be missing.
Since 24 October 2025, no registered office address changes were filed, and one officer resignation was filed: PERSON 421 (director, 6 May 2026).
